ai.title: Add requireSlash flag to CLI command processing
ai.summary: Added `requireSlash` boolean to `CommandInfo` interface in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` and implemented early check in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` `processCommand`. Commands with `requireSlash: true` (e.g., `/reset`, `/compact`) now forward raw input to backend if slash is missing, preventing accidental local execution. Cost mode commands also respect this flag via `interactiveCommandDetails` lookup. Scope limited to CLI command routing logic; no user-facing behavior change for valid slash commands.

eli5.text: When you type certain commands like /reset or /compact without the leading slash, the system now sends your input straight to the backend instead of trying to run it locally. This acts as a safety net so you don't accidentally trigger these powerful commands by typing reset or compact on their own. A new setting was added behind the scenes that tells the command processor which commands require the slash prefix to work locally, and cost mode commands now respect that same rule.

ai.title: Dynamic agent template loading fix
ai.summary: DynamicAgentService now loads agent templates from fileContext.agentTemplates instead of reading .agents/templates from disk. This fixes validation errors caused by missing files or path issues. Scope covers backend/src/templates/dynamic-agent-service.ts and common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts. The override field in DynamicAgentTemplateSchema is now optional with default false, preventing validation failures on templates omitting it.

eli5.text: Starting today, the system loads your custom assistant templates from the project's active configuration instead of searching for files on disk, so missing or misplaced template files no longer cause validation errors. If a template omits the "override" field, it now defaults to false instead of failing validation. This affects anyone using custom dynamic agent templates in their project.
